method: Built-in image_gen for visual exploration; native SVG and Android VectorDrawable contours for final production assets.
appPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one final Android launcher icon for the Chinese app 破茧 (emerging from an information cocoon), also establishing the identity for its small floating bubble.
Primary request: design an original, highly distilled opening-cocoon symbol, confident and calm. A compact upright cocoon made of TWO substantial white interlocking curved shell/wing shapes separated by a generous diagonal blue negative-space opening rising toward the upper right. The left shape cups inward like an opened protective shell. The right shape unfolds outward like a single abstract wing. A single small but broad light cyan segment at the upper-right end is integrated into the right wing. The two shapes together suggest a cocoon opening and perspective expanding. No literal insect and no person. Geometric yet organic; few deliberate curves, thick solid shapes, no thin lines. Excellent recognition at 32 pixels.
Color palette: flat solid royal blue #2563EB full-bleed square background; white #FFFFFF primary mark, one restrained ice cyan #8DE8F2 accent. No gradients.
Composition: square 1:1; ONE centered compact emblem occupying only the central 52% of canvas in both width and height, remaining completely inside a centered circle of radius 30% of the canvas. Generous empty blue margins are intentional for Android adaptive icon masks. Full blue background touches all four edges; do not render an inset tile.
Style: refined flat vector-like contemporary identity with optically balanced contours and clean crisp edges. A usable production app icon.
Constraints: zero text, zero lettering, no slogan, no wordmark, no watermark, no mockup, no border, no drawn rounded square, no shadow, no 3D, no glow, no texture. Avoid generic refresh arrows, paper airplanes, leaves, flame, bird, human heads, thin cocoon stripes, decorative particles or multiple nested rings.
bubblePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final desktop floating-bubble logo paired with the attached 破茧 app icon.
Input image 1 is the identity reference and edit target. Preserve the exact recognizable contours, orientation and spacing of its white opened-cocoon symbol and upper-right ice-cyan wing tip. Do not redesign or add any elements.
Primary request: convert the square app icon into one compact circular floating bubble asset. Keep the same royal blue #2563EB background INSIDE one clean perfect circle and make everything OUTSIDE the circle genuinely transparent. The circle is centered and occupies 94% of this square canvas; the same emblem is centered inside it and occupies 58% of the circle width, with sufficient interior padding. Render the emblem with uniform solid white and ice cyan #8DE8F2, removing any texture, and keep the blue circle solid and uniform. Broad, clear negative spaces are important at the actual 44dp display size.
Keep flat, crisp, optically balanced contours. No shadow, no glow, no glass, no bevel, no outline stroke. One circle containing one emblem only. NO text, lettering, watermark, decorative dots, comparison sheet, device mockup, background scene or checkerboard pattern. Transparency outside the circle is required.
note: The generated bubble reference was discarded because of imperfect alpha edges. Both production icons share the same manually normalized vector contours.
